definition: Customized means altered from the standard version to fit one particular user or purpose.
task: Write one sentence of your own using the word customized. Make the sentence show what the word means -- a reader who did not know customized should be able to work it out from your sentence.
avoid_verbatim: The clinic's customized hearing aids are molded from an impression of each patient's ear, so no two on the shelf match.
Adjusted is milder than customized: an adjusted chair got one lever moved for you, while a customized one has been genuinely reworked around a single sitter.
Bespoke goes further than customized — a customized product starts standard and is altered to fit, but a bespoke one is made to order from the first sketch and never existed in a standard version.

Tailored keeps the image of the fitting room — cutting and trimming what already exists to one wearer's measurements. Customized covers any product bent to its user, from software to saddles, with no cloth in sight.
Personalized can be as light as a monogram — your name stamped on the standard thing. Customized goes deeper: the thing itself is altered until it fits one user's needs, not just labeled as theirs.

After his grandmother's stroke left her cooking one-handed, Tomás customized her kitchen a drawer at a time.
The cutting board grew steel pegs to hold vegetables still; the kettle sat in a cradle that tipped at a touch; her favorite pans moved to a shelf exactly at elbow height.
Catalog gadgets had failed her for a year — every one designed for some average cook who wasn't her.
Customized is the right word because each change was fitted to one particular user: not a better kitchen in general, but her kitchen, measured against her reach and her working hand.
That's the test the word sets — start from the standard thing, then bend it to the individual.
The catalog's one-size gadgets are the perfect foil: generic is exactly what customized exists to correct.

When nothing standard ever existed, reach past customized to bespoke.

Nobody on the wheelchair rugby team plays in the chair they were prescribed.
The stock frame is a starting point, the way a factory guitar is a starting point for a touring musician.
Each chair is customized over a season: the seat angle changed for a player's balance, the wheels cambered for his turning style, guards shaped around how she takes hits.
